Primex Visa Pvt. Ltd. Advertises New Visa Documentation Executive Position in Delhi

Overview of the Role

Primex Visa Pvt. Ltd., an immigration and visa consultancy based in Delhi, India, has posted a recruitment notice for a full-time, on-site Visa Documentation Executive. According to the company description provided in the job listing, the firm handles permanent residency, work, study, tourist, and business visas for various international destinations.

The posted role centers on managing end-to-end visa paperwork. Confirmed responsibilities detailed in the notice include:

  • Collecting, verifying, and organizing client documentation.
  • Assisting clients with completing application forms to meet embassy and consulate criteria.
  • Maintaining internal record-keeping systems and tracking application statuses.
  • Communicating with clients via phone, email, and in-person consultations.

Candidate Requirements

The listing outlines several qualifications sought for the position:

  • Education: A minimum of a bachelor’s degree or equivalent in any discipline.
  • Skills: Strong administrative, organizational, and documentation abilities, alongside basic computer proficiency.
  • Experience: Prior background in visa consultancy, travel, or immigration services is noted as an advantage.

How to Verify

Applicants interested in reviewing the full description or verifying current availability can access the original job posting directly through professional networking platforms such as LinkedIn via the Primex Visa Pvt. Ltd. company page.
